result: Under (L0, L1)-smoothness, where gradients may grow superlinearly and no global Lipschitz constant exists, tamed SGD (step divided by 1 + λtr(x)) and a dissipative variant converge almost surely to critical points and avoid strict saddle manifolds with probability one.
result_plain: Tamed SGD converges a.s. and avoids strict saddles without a global Lipschitz gradient, under (L0,L1)-smoothness.
